arri_skin_d55.name: arri_skin_d55
arri_skin_d55.label: 肤色前馈 · D55
arri_skin_d55.note: Rec.2020-domain demo spectral fit from rough ALEV3/IMX410 curves and a sigmoid Sigma fp hot-mirror model; look_gain amplifies the fitted residual while preserving neutral axis. Replace curves with measured CSV data for production calibration.

alev_material_d55.name: alev_material_d55
alev_material_d55.label: 材质前馈 · D55 实验
alev_material_d55.note: Material-aware Sigma->材质前馈 · D55 实验 separation: per-material constrained fits on D55+A samples (signed responses), windows = colorimetric truth of measured spectra in the D55 frame (runtime window transport applies; skin keeps the photo-fitted window), look_gain=1. Confidence folds fit quality into the effective weight. Data quality per dngscan_assets/spectral/README.md; regenerate after replacing CSVs.
